payload.description_html: Teeth of the hybodont shark Lonchidionoides sp. from the Barremian–Aptian lacustrine deposits of ‘Fazenda Tereza’ (Brazil). (a1–a3), lateral tooth (IGC-P 0093/2) in labial, lingual and occlusal views; (b1–b3) posterior tooth (IGC-P 0093/9) in labial, lingual and occlusal views; (c1–c4) posterior tooth (IGC-P 0093/1) in labial, lingual, occlusal and basal views; (d1–d3) posterior tooth (IGC-P 0093/7) in labial, occlusal and basal views; (e1–e3) posteriormost tooth (IGC-P 0093/8) in labial, lingual and occlusal views. Scale bar equals 500 μm
